email.subject: Tide Works Hair Studio — quick site fix
email.body:
Hi Maria,

I looked at Tide Works Hair Studio's site. Two things are likely costing you bookings: it doesn't display correctly on phones, and there's no tap-to-call button, so mobile visitors can't ring you directly from the page. Since most salon searches happen on phones, that's probably turning lookers into no-shows before they ever call.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's broken and how I'd fix it? No pressure either way.

Alex
Northlight Web
